content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Beats online

Selling beats online using conventional methods can be costly and restrictive, particularly due to high commission fees from platforms like Gumroad, which takes 10% on every sale. By using a crypto-based infrastructure, you can significantly reduce costs. For instance, with NOWPayments, your fees are only 0.5%. This means that for 100 sales of a $97 beat, you would save $921 compared to using Gumroad. This approach not only cuts expenses but also gives you complete ownership of your sales channel.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure for selling beats online without traditional payment platforms involves several key components working together seamlessly. You will host your digital storefront on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which are free and reliable. For backend processing, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle order logic and payment verification. All transactions are processed through NOWPayments, allowing you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. This architecture ensures that you retain full control over your data and operations.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators who are locked out of traditional payment systems due to regional restrictions or high fees. Musicians, educators, and designers can all benefit from this infrastructure. By using this framework, you can sell ebooks, courses, templates, and beats without the burden of platform fees. This is particularly relevant in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela, where payment processing options are limited and unreliable.
Using crypto payments can save you significant fees compared to traditional platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this infrastructure include a hosting service, a backend processing system, an order storage solution, and a payment processor. Hosting your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages ensures your site is accessible and efficient. The backend is managed through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which take care of order confirmations and delivery. For storing orders, you can use Supabase or Google Sheets. Finally, NOWPayments enables you to accept cryptocurrency, ensuring seamless transactions without traditional banking restrictions.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first set up your storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, implement backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Configure your order storage with Supabase or Google Sheets. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions, making sure to choose networks like BSC or Solana for lower fees. Finally, upload your products and test the entire workflow. For comprehensive guidance, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing a decentralized infrastructure that leverages cryptocurrency payments. This allows you to bypass traditional payment processors entirely, giving you full control over your sales and reducing fees significantly. By implementing tools like NOWPayments, you can easily accept various cryptocurrencies, ensuring instant delivery and verification of payments.
You own your infrastructure, ensuring no third-party platform can lock you out.

If you're looking to sell digital products without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip, this infrastructure is the solution. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers everything you need to build, deploy, and scale your own sovereign digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more details.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

NOWPayments charges a low fee of 0.5% on every transaction, significantly lower than traditional platforms. This enables you to keep more of your earnings while processing payments in various cryptocurrencies.

You can automate delivery by using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage order confirmations and file delivery, ensuring your customers receive their purchases instantly after payment.
